message: We hold a commanding position and the summit will confirm our control of this region's resources. We have demonstrated the full range of our capabilities and see no need for further escalation. We call on Beta to accept the outcome that is already determined.
reasoning: Alpha controls 55% vs Beta's 10% with the pool at 35%. We already win at freeze regardless of this final round.
